author: Staffan Greisz
description: Self-hosted, local-first Business Intelligence platform with interactive dashboards, AI-powered analysis, and a conversational voice assistant called Ralph. Alternative to Power BI and Tableau that runs entirely on your own machine.
north_star: Time from raw data upload to first actionable insight under 60 seconds

tech_stack.geo_visualization: Deck.gl (MIT) + MapLibre GL JS (BSD 3-Clause) — GPU-accelerated geo layers, no API key required

repository_structure.frontend/src/components/: UI components (charts, dashboard, editor, voice, geo)
repository_structure.frontend/src/components/geo/: Deck.gl map layers (ScatterplotLayer, HexagonLayer, ArcLayer, HeatmapLayer, GeoJsonLayer)
repository_structure.frontend/src/services/: API client, DuckDB-WASM init, WebSocket voice
repository_structure.backend/api/: Route handlers (auth, data, dashboards, ai, voice, n8n)
repository_structure.backend/services/: Business logic (ai, duckdb, alerts, export, n8n)
repository_structure.scripts/: Dev setup and seed data helpers

phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: Working local BI tool — file upload, charts, SQL editor, dashboard builder

phases.name: Intelligence
phases.goal: AI analysis, natural language to SQL, insight engine, deck generator

phases.name: Voice
phases.goal: Hey Ralph voice assistant — push-to-talk, wake word, spoken responses

phases.name: Connectivity
phases.goal: Live data sources, n8n pipelines, scheduled refresh, alerts, export

features.name: Docker Compose stack
features.description: Full dev and prod Docker Compose setup: FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Nginx. Single command startup.

features.name: File ingestion
features.description: Drag-and-drop upload for CSV, JSON, Parquet, Excel. Auto-detect schema and column types. Store as DuckDB database file per workspace.

features.name: DuckDB-WASM query engine
features.description: Initialize DuckDB-WASM in browser. Load uploaded data files. Execute SQL queries client-side. Sub-500ms response target.

features.name: Chart library — Apache ECharts
features.description: Bar, Line, Area, Scatter, Pie, Donut, Radar, KPI card, Data Table using Apache ECharts (Apache License 2.0). Each chart takes a SQL query and renders result. Click to drill down. Canvas and SVG rendering modes. Handles 10M+ data points via progressive rendering.

features.name: Dashboard builder
features.description: Drag-and-drop grid canvas using react-grid-layout. Add, resize, reorder chart cards. Add text/markdown blocks. Save dashboard as JSON.

features.name: SQL editor
features.description: Monaco-based SQL IDE with syntax highlighting, schema explorer sidebar, query history, result preview as table or chart.

features.name: Interactive filters
features.description: Date range picker, dropdown, multi-select, search box filter components. Filters apply across all linked charts on dashboard instantly.

features.name: User authentication
features.description: JWT-based auth. Register, login, logout. bcrypt password hashing. Protected API routes. Per-user workspace isolation.

features.name: Dashboard persistence
features.description: Save dashboards to PostgreSQL. Load, rename, delete. Export dashboard config as portable JSON file. Import from JSON.

features.name: AI text-to-SQL
features.description: Natural language query input. Send question + schema context to Claude API. Execute generated SQL. Display result as chart or table automatically.

features.name: Observable Plot — AI exploratory charts
features.description: Use Observable Plot (ISC license) for AI-generated exploratory visualizations. Claude generates Plot specs as JSON declaratively — faster and more reliable than generating imperative ECharts config. AI chat panel renders responses as Plot charts automatically. Users can promote Plot charts to full ECharts dashboard cards.

features.name: AI insight engine
features.description: On data upload, Claude analyzes schema and sample rows. Auto-generates insight cards: trends, anomalies, correlations, outliers with plain English explanations.

features.name: AI chat panel
features.description: Right sidebar chat interface. Ask questions about current dataset in plain English. Conversation history maintained per session. Responses include charts when relevant.

features.name: Deck generator
features.description: One-click AI deck generation. Claude reads dataset, builds complete analysis presentation: charts, narrative, key findings, and recommendations. Rendered as interactive deck.

features.name: Data quality scoring
features.description: Scan uploaded dataset for missing values, type mismatches, duplicates, outliers. Display quality score card with actionable cleaning suggestions.

features.name: Deck.gl geo-visualization layer
features.description: Integrate @deck.gl/react + MapLibre GL JS. Auto-detect lat/lon or geographic columns in uploaded data. Offer map chart type in dashboard builder. GPU-accelerated rendering handles millions of points in browser.

features.name: Deck.gl layer types
features.description: Implement ScatterplotLayer (point data), HexagonLayer (density aggregation), HeatmapLayer (intensity), ArcLayer (origin-destination flows), GeoJsonLayer (polygon/boundary data). Each selectable as chart type in dashboard builder.

features.name: AI geo-column detection
features.description: Claude detects geographic columns in dataset schema (lat/lon pairs, country names, region codes, postal codes). Automatically suggests Deck.gl map as recommended chart type. Can geocode named regions via lookup table.

features.name: Voice assistant core
features.description: OpenAI Realtime API WebSocket connection. Push-to-talk button: hold to record, release to send. Audio streamed to GPT-4o. Response audio streamed back and played.

features.name: Wake word detection
features.description: 'Hey Ralph' wake word triggers voice mode hands-free. Uses Web Speech API for continuous listening when enabled. Visual indicator when listening.

features.name: Voice command routing
features.description: Classify voice intent: query | filter | export | narrate | generate. Route data queries to Claude for SQL. Update dashboard visually while speaking response.

features.name: Dashboard narration
features.description: Ralph reads dashboard aloud chart by chart with AI-generated narrative and recommendations. 'Narrate this dashboard' command.

features.name: Voice transcript panel
features.description: Rolling transcript of voice interactions. Searchable history. Click past query to re-run. Copy transcript as text.

features.name: n8n webhook integration
features.description: FastAPI webhook endpoints that n8n can POST data to. Auto-ingest into DuckDB workspace. Support for scheduled pushes and trigger-based updates.

features.name: Database connectors
features.description: Direct connection to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite. Connection string config. Query live database tables from within Ralph.

features.name: Scheduled refresh
features.description: Cron-based dashboard data refresh. Config per data source. Last refreshed timestamp displayed on dashboard.

features.name: Alert engine
features.description: Define threshold rules on metrics. Ralph triggers browser notification, email, or n8n webhook when condition is met.

features.name: Export engine
features.description: Export dashboard as PDF report. Individual charts as PNG/SVG. Data as CSV or Excel. Scheduled email reports via SMTP.

open_source_commitment.policy: All visualization and frontend libraries must be open source with permissive licenses. No vendor lock-in, no API keys required for core rendering.

non_functional_requirements.data_privacy: local-first, no data leaves machine without explicit config
non_functional_requirements.api_key_storage: encrypted in PostgreSQL, never exposed to frontend

frontend_design.instruction: When building any frontend component or page, invoke the frontend-design skill and follow all aesthetic guidelines below. Never produce generic AI-slop UI.
frontend_design.aesthetic_direction: Retro-futuristic editorial — a local intelligence terminal with warmth and personality. Think Springfield meets mission control: amber-on-dark, monospace precision, occasional irreverent charm. Data-dense but never cold.
frontend_design.memorable_trait: Every screen feels like a personal war-room built by someone who actually loves their data. Nothing looks like a SaaS dashboard.

typography.display_font: DM Serif Display or Playfair Display — for headings, dashboard titles, insight card headlines
typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans — clean, technical, slightly editorial
typography.monospace_font: JetBrains Mono or Fira Code — for SQL editor, query results, schema explorer, all numbers
typography.sizing: Generous scale contrast — large display titles (3–5rem) paired with tight data labels (0.7rem)

color_palette.secondary_accent: #E84393 — hot pink for alerts, anomalies, voice active state

motion.philosophy: Purposeful, not decorative. Data loading feels like a machine waking up. Transitions are crisp, not floaty.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up reveals with animation-delay increments (0ms, 80ms, 160ms...). Header locks in first, then content panels cascade.
motion.charts: ECharts built-in enter animations enabled. Bar charts grow from baseline. Line charts draw left-to-right.
motion.hover_states: Subtle amber glow on interactive cards. Border color shifts to accent on focus.
motion.voice_active: Pulsing ring animation on Ralph avatar when listening. Pink secondary accent.
motion.library: Use Motion (Framer Motion) for React page transitions and complex sequences. CSS keyframes for simple states.

layout.philosophy: Asymmetric density. Left sidebar for navigation/schema is tight and utilitarian. Main canvas is open. Right panels (AI chat, filters) slide in as overlays.
layout.grid: 12-column CSS Grid at macro level. react-grid-layout handles dashboard card placement.
layout.sidebar_width: 240px collapsed-capable nav. Collapses to 48px icon rail.
layout.spacing_scale: 4px base unit. Use 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96px — nothing in between.
layout.borders: 1px solid #2A2A2A for structure. No rounded corners on data-dense components (tables, editors). Subtle radius (6px) on cards and buttons only.

backgrounds_and_texture.app_background: Near-black #0D0D0D with a very subtle noise texture overlay (opacity 0.03) for warmth
backgrounds_and_texture.dashboard_canvas: Slightly lighter surface with a faint dot-grid pattern at 24px spacing, color #1A1A1A
backgrounds_and_texture.insight_cards: Dark surface with a 1px amber left-border accent strip
backgrounds_and_texture.sql_editor: Full black with green-tinted syntax highlighting (not default Monaco blue theme)

components.ralph_avatar: Persistent small circular avatar in bottom-left or nav — shows Ralph's mood (idle/listening/thinking/responding). Animated.
components.kpi_cards: Large number in display font, amber color. Trend indicator (arrow + percentage) in smaller monospace below. Dark card with subtle top-border glow.
components.chart_cards: Minimal chrome — title in IBM Plex Sans, chart fills card. Hover reveals action icons (edit, fullscreen, export). No decorative padding.
components.sql_editor: Full Monaco editor, dark theme with amber cursor, custom dark background matching app palette.
components.upload_zone: Animated dashed border that becomes solid amber on drag-over. Subtle scanline animation while processing.
components.voice_button: Large circular push-to-talk button — glows pink when active, amber ring when processing

ralph_personality_ui.idle_message: My cat's breath smells like cat food
ralph_personality_ui.low_confidence: I don't know what's happening but I can feel it
ralph_personality_ui.success_deck: I made something with my brain!
ralph_personality_ui.placement: These appear as toast notifications, loading states, and empty state copy — never as blocking UI

forbidden_patterns: Purple or blue gradient hero sections
Rounded pill buttons with drop shadows
Generic card grid with equal padding everywhere
Flat icon sets (Material Icons, Heroicons defaults)
Skeleton loaders that look like Facebook/LinkedIn
Centered layout with max-width 800px and white background
Cookie-cutter SaaS navbar with logo left + CTA right

success_criteria.phase_1: Upload CSV, build 3-chart dashboard, save it — under 5 minutes
success_criteria.phase_2: Ask 'What are my top 5 customers by revenue?' and get a correct chart
success_criteria.phase_3: Say 'Hey Ralph, what should I focus on this week?' and get spoken + visual answer
success_criteria.phase_4: n8n pushes daily data automatically, dashboard refreshes, alert fires on threshold breach
